# Native OpenSpec differential vectors

`native-parser-vectors.json` records 50 bounded cases generated by executing
the original `extractRequirementsSection` and `parseDeltaSpec` functions at
[OpenSpec e062b957](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/tree/e062b9572be933564ba3899d059377dfa1393e32/src/core/parsers).
The JSON provenance records SHA-256 hashes of the three original source
files. Runtime copies change only relative `.js` import filenames to
`.runtime.ts`, permitting Node 24 native TypeScript stripping.

Fence cases cover accepted and active delta catalogs, native whitespace,
marker/length/info boundaries, body digests and the first accepted section.
Twelve repeated-section cases cover all four operations with exact titles,
case variants and empty final sections. Native selects one section; Lekalo
explicitly rejects the entire provider for this unsupported input. Distinct
operation sections (including reversed order) and fenced duplicates are
valid controls. `archiveAccepted` applies the recorded native plan in
RENAMED/REMOVED/MODIFIED/ADDED order to private accepted text.

The CLI tests assert exact catalogs and revisions, fresh/denied gates,
missing excluded references, neutral trace validation, absent confirmed
edges for examples, no writes, and trace equality across a native-plan disk
archive transition. No OpenSpec install or network is required by the
committed suite. The vectors do not claim exhaustive native equivalence or
execution of the OpenSpec archive CLI.

Generation script, original source copies, full native plans, fresh
fail-before/pass-after command streams, exact Ajv 8.17.1 checks and file
snapshots are preserved in the correction artifact directory:
`C:/Users/User/orca/artifacts/lekalo-m2-20260908/issue-36-fix-3-evidence/`.
The generator is `generate-vectors.mjs`; its inputs and output hashes are
recorded with the final correction report.
